dict.string: Entries are based on the build history and previous testing. “Experimental” describes a test, not a completed feature.
v0.2.71 — Ranger dock, Spotify Home and CarLy

Places Home and the clock on the left and groups live signal, network and battery on the right. Styles the Spotify Home items CarPlay offers in limited mode. Draws an explicit Back chevron and hands the player to CarLy when lyrics open
v0.2.70 — Spotify touch targets and shared dock

Centres artwork and playback buttons over the blurred album background, aligns touch targets with their visible controls, styles pushed Spotify lists, and applies the compact bottom dock across CarPlay with Settings removed from the dock
Compact tabs and a working Now Playing bar on all four browse screens, translucent list styling, measured Home shelves, full-player artwork blur and a smaller glass dock with native app shortcuts

Centres the four native Spotify tabs in a compact teal pill, adjusts shelf captions and spacing, and tints the enabled dark glass dock blue while Spotify is foreground. Reads missing mix titles from legible cover text and shows available artist names beneath the artwork.
Supplies the Liked Songs shortcut title when its confirmed heart artwork is present and Spotify provides no readable caption.
Reads the Recents template when available and remembers titles matched to Home artwork for the next launch.
Rechecks visible Spotify Home rows for late-arriving titles and refreshes the title catalogue when Home reloads.
v0.2.64 — Spotify Home labels and selections
Filters identifier-like captions, reads available image titles and reuses Spotify metadata from visited lists. Compacts shelf headings and text-only Home selections.
Groups settings by function and gives every switch an information button. The Spotify page keeps its Home, navigation and report controls together. Adds the new CarPlay26 icon to Settings

Adds two-column shortcuts, six-column artwork shelves, inline headings and a fixed teal and blue backdrop. Uses live Spotify artwork and native selection. Expanded sections supply additional items and captions when available.
v0.2.61 — Spotify Home and dashboard soft-glass finishes

Bundles two narrowly targeted cosmetic refinements: soft translucent gradients behind verified Spotify four-artwork Home rows when Home Styling is enabled, and a subtle sheen on the existing two lower Dashboard widget materials with Glass Dashboard Cards. Retains stock maps, native controls, animated Spotify pill, public-build wallpaper restrictions and existing Sileo workflow. Build and dark/light WinPlay testing required.

Slides the selected tab capsule between Spotify native tabs with a 0.26-second ease-in/out animation, supporting rapid retaps without a visible reset. No animation on first load or geometry changes; respects Reduce Motion. Preserves symmetric spacing, pressed feedback, now playing, live toggles and native hit targets. Requires WinPlay testing.
v0.2.59 — Spotify pill feedback and even padding

Bundles a pressed-tab feedback capsule, mathematically symmetric selected-pill padding, and consistent selected/pressed label colours in one release to reduce workflow runs. The native iOS 16 press highlight stays hidden; native tab controls and hit targets remain intact. Preserves early navigation, Now Playing, live Home Styling and feature restoration when disabled. Requires GitHub build and WinPlay validation.
v0.2.58 — Suppress native pressed tab highlights

Fixes old blue/grey iOS 16 rectangular tab highlights appearing when holding Spotify navigation tabs. Only the stock non-interactive UITabBarButton highlight view is hidden and restored on disable; native touch handling, labels, Now Playing, early pill startup and independent Home Styling remain unchanged. Slightly refines the inner selection capsule. GitHub build and WinPlay press/release verification required.
v0.2.57 — Spotify pills without Now Playing dependency

Removes the requirement for Spotify's separate Now Playing button to exist before applying the four-tab navigation pill. Accepts the native tab layout when it initially fills the bar or reserves space for the later Now Playing control, retaining tab geometry checks and Spotify-only protection. Labels, selection, native actions, Home Styling, diagnostics, wallpapers, dock and Airaw unchanged. Build and WinPlay testing required.
v0.2.56 — Faster Spotify pill startup and centred labels

Requests confirmed Spotify foreground state immediately on the template-host main queue, with a short retry before the existing fallback requests. Centres native tab labels after UIKit button layout using a guard limited to Spotify's verified pill navigation. Preserves native tap areas, selected capsule, Now Playing, working Home Styling and live switches. Build and WinPlay testing required.

Adds an independent off-by-default iOS 26-style native pill navigation switch. Verified v0.2.54 report shows four UITabBarButtons and a separate Now Playing button. Visually hides native icons, centers existing labels and draws selected capsule while retaining original tap handlers/positions; restores native subview properties on disable or foreground loss. Existing Home Styling and diagnostic capture unchanged. Requires build and WinPlay testing.

Extends the working Spotify report with bounded read-only CPSNavigationBar and tab-control inspection: view geometry, selected/highlighted/enabled states, subview classes, backing layers and separate Now Playing controller state. No labels or music data are read. Existing v0.2.53 live Home Styling, playback, dock, wallpaper and Airaw remain untouched. Requires compilation and WinPlay confirmation.

Spotify Home Styling now applies when changed in Settings without restarting CarPlay or respringing. Explicit preference get/set callbacks save the existing switch value and send ON/OFF Darwin notifications. The native CarPlay foreground-app observer remains active even if styling was off at launch, letting the template host restore or clear the existing artwork rows immediately. No layout, playback, dock, wallpaper, Airaw or diagnostic changes. Device verification required.

The v0.2.51 report proved native backgrounds and layers were changing correctly. The previous 12% dark tint over a light background simply reproduced stock panel grey. The opt-in Spotify Home Styling test now fully clears eligible four-artwork row backgrounds and restores their original colour and opaque flag when Spotify loses foreground status. Table and content backing transparency, controls, layout, playback and diagnostics remain unchanged. This does not add iOS 26 wallpaper blur. Build and WinPlay testing required.

Extends the existing read-only Spotify layout report to inspect active image-row backgroundConfiguration, background and selectedBackgroundView, layer colours and sublayers. No styling changes; keep Spotify Home Styling off when taking the next report. Compilation and device verification required.

Adds opt-in Spotify Home Styling (Experimental) on the existing Spotify settings page. Uses native CarPlay dock activeBundleIdentifier state relayed to CarPlayTemplateUIHost by Darwin notification; only Spotify foreground image-row cells matching the observed four-artwork structure get a translucent background. The native colour is restored when Spotify loses focus. Does not change layout, buttons, playback, navigation, wallpapers, dock or Airaw. Off by default; restart CarPlay Services to apply. Requires build and WinPlay verification.

Diagnostic proof confirmed v0.2.49 applies its transparent artwork-row tint, but opaque CPSTableView and its immediate UIView content canvas remain behind it. v0.2.50 conditionally clears these two confirmed backing surfaces only for Spotify foreground artwork rows and preserves their original colours and opacity for restoration. No media, navigation, wallpaper or layout modifications; WinPlay testing required.

Introduced opt-in Spotify-only image-row tint and foreground-app checks. On-device diagnostics confirmed the tint reached CPSImageRowCell; the effect was visually hidden by native opaque backing views. No layout or playback modifications.
v0.2.48 — Spotify settings and diagnostic capture

Adds a dedicated Spotify settings page and an opt-in, read-only CarPlayTemplateUIHost view inventory. Capture requests save view class names, view geometry and visual metadata in the template host process container. Song titles, playlists, contacts and message contents are not recorded. No Spotify appearance or playback changes are included. Device testing required.

Reduces installed wallpaper storage by packaging six patterned colourways with 2048px full-size and 512px thumbnail JPEGs at high quality (92, 4:4:4), retaining all light/dark images and three solid-colour PNG choices. Native wallpaper picker, identifiers and loader behaviour are unchanged apart from format selection; the old PNG file extension remains a fallback. Build asserts all 36 resources. Device verification is still required.

When iOS 26 App Launcher Icon is enabled, show the outlined square only on the Home app grid, and the nine-square grid on the Dashboard and in foreground CarPlay apps. Reuse native DBAppDockViewController activeBundleIdentifier state in addition to the existing page geometry; preserve the animated fade, native Home button actions, dock, Airaw layout and all other styling. App transitions require WinPlay verification.
v0.2.45 — Native card tint and diagnostics

Restores visible Glass Dashboard Cards by placing a transparent borderless tint on the native card material rather than behind it or inside a second rounded panel. Diagnostic reports now try writable process-owned cache and temporary locations when the shared Documents path is unavailable. Notification badges, icon labels and the launcher are unchanged. Device verification required.

Uses the outer native dashboard card surface rather than adding an inset glass panel. Preserves the system card border and widget controls. Keeps icon rims visible with a small gap where notification badges overlap. Original labels, launcher transition, dock and wallpaper remain unchanged. Device testing required.
v0.2.43 — Launcher, badges and dashboard cards

Outlined-square home launcher blends into the Dashboard nine-square grid during navigation. Icon rim decoration now renders below native badge accessories or hides while a notification badge is present. The two lower dashboard cards get a quieter light-mode glass tint and border, without modifying widgets, map, text or actions. Light/dark app labels and Airaw grid unchanged. Device testing required.
v0.2.42 — Balanced labels and dashboard glass

Light-mode glass labels are lighter than v0.2.41 but retain more contrast than v0.2.40. Both native and fallback capsules keep measured widths and white text. Lower dashboard widget cards receive subtly rounded 20-point decorative corners, soft three-stop glass tint and quiet blue-grey borders; media control rims are toned down. Native map, widget layout, button actions, dark icon labels, dock and Airaw are untouched. On-device verification required.

In light CarPlay appearance, app-label backgrounds use a darker smoky-grey translucent fill for clearer white text on bright wallpapers. Dark-mode labels, adaptive label sizing, dashboard, dock, and Airaw layout are unchanged. Device testing required.

Glass label backdrops use the measured native app title width with balanced padding. Preserves native text, icon position, spacing and Airaw grid layout. If a title or existing material mask is unavailable, retains stock geometry. Device testing required.

Darker icon-label backings with quieter edges and more subtle dashboard card tint/borders. Existing Glass Icon Labels and Glass Dashboard Cards switches still control these effects. Layout and native controls unchanged. [Device testing required]
Optional startup splash, Apple Maps dark appearance, and native corner overlay tests. All default off; testing required. CarPlay Phone driving-related keypad restriction remains in place.
Add opt-in rounded-square outline to the native CarPlay home/app-launcher button. Keep original dock location, app shortcuts, layout, interactions and wallpapers. [Awaiting device test]

Replace all nine image wallpaper slots with six archived iOS 26 patterned designs and three solid-colour options. Light/dark variants, native picker/preview/home screen, plus dedicated Diagnostics and Changelog pages. [Testing required]
Confirmed green banner on the native CarPlay home screen, automatic reapplication after respring and correct disappearance when switching to a different wallpaper. [Confirmed]
Confirmed CarPlayWallpaper creates the selected wallpaper controller and displays a 2048×2048 image in its own CarPlay window. [Observed]
Successfully overlaid a blue test banner on the top-left wallpaper thumbnail and preview; the actual home screen remained unchanged. [Confirmed]
Identified the 11 stock wallpaper IDs, 512×512 picker thumbnails and 2048×2048 full images in CRSUIWallpaper. [Confirmed]
Inspected CRSUIWallpaper and preference methods, with synchronous, read-only model hooks. [Diagnostic]
Added delayed native class detection and independent capture attempts. [Diagnostic]
Tested native wallpaper controller hooks and gathered the first focused CarPlay class inventory. [Diagnostic]
Added automatic native wallpaper screen capture attempts without relying on a shared setting. [Diagnostic]
Consolidated diagnostic switches on the main page and added Capture Wallpaper Report. [Settings and diagnostic]
Narrowed inspection to native CarPlay wallpaper picker and display classes. [Diagnostic]
Improved fallback output paths for wallpaper reports. [Diagnostic]
Added a deterministic startup report and explicit requests to wallpaper processes. [Diagnostic]
Added process startup diagnostics and sandbox-aware report paths. [Diagnostic]
Introduced read-only hooks to inspect the official CarPlay wallpaper picker. [Diagnostic]
Added optional Liquid Glass-inspired reflections and highlights to the working dock. [Confirmed]
Successfully pinned Messages in the right-hand native dock shortcut position, retaining other shortcuts. [Confirmed]
Introduced an initial pinned shortcut experiment and supporting instrumentation. [Experimental]
Inspected the native dock buttons and recent-app selection methods. [Diagnostic]
Fixed white background flashes between CarPlay app pages by guarding the native dock backing. [Confirmed]
Continued testing the independent glass dock backing and transition behaviour. [Experimental]
Tested a distinct glass dock material while retaining native controls. [Experimental]
Updated glass dock capsule clipping and added Restart CarPlay Services. [Experimental]
Refined the glass dock transition behaviour. [Experimental]
Tested transparent backing changes to the native dock. [Experimental]
Iterated on the experimental native dock capsule and its rendering. [Experimental]
Introduced a native glass dock appearance experiment. [Experimental]
Expanded native dock and status bar inspection. [Diagnostic]
Added a working Respring action to CarPlay26 settings. [Confirmed]
Improved immediate glass styling on dashboard cards and media controls. [Confirmed]
Added glass label backgrounds for icon views without a usable native backdrop. [Confirmed]
Fixed glass styling appearing late when scrolling between CarPlay app pages. [Confirmed]
Added separate glass surface options and validated that the tweak changes WinPlay appearance. [Confirmed]
Tested overlay effects on existing CarPlay material views. [Experimental]
Added initial automatic appearance handling and experimental dock styling. [Experimental]
Introduced an independent experimental CarPlay26 tweak and icon appearance preview. [Experimental]
